Name: Seasonal Female Bachelors talkohlooey Style
Author: landingamer101
Description:
I got bored one day and realized that, despite having provided a base, no one has made a seasonal portraits mod for the' female bachelors with talkohlooey's portraits. It was very surprising to me considering how popular both the female bachelors and talkohlooeys portraits are (some of the most downloaded things on Nexus), and with no limitations on editing them, I thought I'd give my own shot at it. It wasn't the easiest thing ever by a long shot, but I got it done, and decided to bundle in the seasonal overworld sprites by LadyoftheLight to make it a complete package.

Comes with Beach sprites as well.

[b][size=6]Disclaimer: This Mod is a replacer. I don't feel like learning how to use Content Patcher for this little upload. [/size]
[size=4]
[i]Requirements (If you want to have a simple drag and drop into mod folder installation): [/i][/size][/b]

[list]
[*][b]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic.[/b]
[/list][list]
[*][b]1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits[/b]
[*][b]1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits Unofficial 1.6 Update[/b]
[*][b]Invatorzen's Dialogue Changes[/b]
[/list]
Credits go to, obviously, talkohlooeys for the female bachelor's portrait base, Adarin for the designs of all the female bachelors, and as I mentioned earlier, LadyoftheLight for the overworld sprite edits. Without them, this would've been an incomplete package, so go show them some love on their [b]Seasonal Female BachelorSeasonal Female Bachelor Portraits and Sprites[/b] mod. 

Oh yeah, I haven't had the chance to bug-test these by the way. Everything should work fine, but let me know if there are any issues and I'll quickly fix them.
